name: Relative Lock-Time via Sequence Numbers
nameZh: 通过序列号实现相对时间锁定
summary: Enables relative lock-time using transaction sequence numbers, allowing inputs to specify a relative time constraint before they can be spent. This is the foundation for bi-directional payment channels.
summaryZh: 使用交易序列号实现相对时间锁定，允许输入在花费前指定相对时间约束。这是双向支付通道的基础。
